༄༅/ /gshin rje khro chu dug gdong nag po'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi bca' gzhi lag len shog dril rgyas pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gshin rje khro chu dug gdong nag po'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi bca' gzhi lag len shog dril rgyas pa bzhugs so//

bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha ya mān+ta ka la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir 'jam dpal las kyi gshin rje rigs gsum 'dus pa khro chu dug gdong sgrub par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/ 'di nyid kyi dkyil 'khor du slob dpon nus ldan las dbang lung legs par thob cing gzhung dang man ngag gi mtha' rgya chod pa'i rnal 'byor pas bsgrub pa'i thabs ni gsum ste/ bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ las la sbyor ba'o// dang po bsnyen pa la dur khrod la sogs pa drag po mngon spyod kyi las su shis pa'i gnas rnams su/ gza' skar 'grub sbyor ram bdud rgyal gang rung dang ldan pa'i dus su/ sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga/ mi nag /rta nag /bya nag /g.yag nag /ra nag /stag gzig la sogs pa'i sha khrag dang*| btsan dug thang khrom la sogs pa'i dug sna dang*/ 'bru sna tshogs pa bsres pa'i chang dang*/ sems can gyi gson khrag gis sbrus pa'i gtor ma zur gsum phur bu'i dbal lta bu la chung ba drug dang*/ gtso bo las chung tsam sde drug las cung zad che ba gcig yum gyi gtor ma ste/ de ltar na 'khor che chung bdun gyis bskor ba la drag po'i rtsang gis bskor zhing rgyan dang ldan pa sha khrag gis sbags pa'i gtor gdugs dang mda' dar gyis spras pa ste/ gtor snod ni lcags sam thod pa la bya'o// gzhan yang bris sku dang rten rdzas la sogs pa'ang bkram/ lcags sam bhan+dha'i snod logs shig tu las gshin spyi gshed kyi gtor ma sha khrag dang rtsang gis brgyan pa'ang bsham/ rtags gtor dang 'dzin gtor gyi rgyu'ang bshad ma thag pa lta bu nyid la bya'o// de ltar bkod legs par bgyis pa'i mdun du pañca a mṛ tas sbags pa'i chang zhim po'i sman mchod dang*/ mi'i khrag gam dud 'gro'i gson khrag la dug sna dang khrag chen gyis sbags pa'i rak+ta dang*/ las byang gi mchod pa byin rlabs nas bshad pa lta bu'i rgyu so sos sbags pa'i mchod pa rnams bsham mo// yang sman gdong dug gi byin rlabs kyi dbang gtor ni/

zan gru gsum gyi ngos mdun du bstan pa'i steng du ro gdan mgo mdun du phyogs pa'i steng du gtor ma zur gsum pa'i ngos mdun du bstan pa rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan par bya 'khor ni med do// dbang gtor ma gtogs bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi gtor ma thams cad ni zur la mdun bya dgos so// de ltar gong du bshad pa ltar bshams zin nas/ sgrub pa po mtshams dam par bya/ gtor ma cha gsum ltar byas la bar chad mi 'byung zhing bsam don 'grub pa'i bka' bsgo/ las byang gzhung bsrang zhing sa mā dhi'i dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i ngang nas rtsa sngags la srung zlog bsad pa'i sham bu ma btags pa kho na ngag bcad la bzla/ nyin mtshan dus drug tu bcad pa'i nyi shar dang*/ nyin gung*/ nyi nub/ nam srod/ nam gung*/ tho rangs te thun drug la gtor ma mtheb skyu dang sha dang sman raka gis gsos la gtor bsngos dang bstod pa gang rung bya/ nangs zhogs lag yig mi mthong ba'i dus tsam nas gshin rje tshe bdag gi mngon rtogs bsgoms shing de'i mjug tu khro chu'i las gzhung bsrang*/ nyin gung gi thun mtshams la rtsa sngags mjug tu yum sngags btags pa sum brgya tsam re bzla/ dgong thun thog la tshogs mchod bya zhing mnga' gsol dang bskang ba bya/ srod thun gyi dus thun gtor re las gshin gyi bskul gyis khang steng du 'bul/ rnam g.yeng dang rgyu dal spangs la/ rab dngos/ 'bring nyams/ tha ma rmi lam du lha 'grub pa'i mtshan ma brtan po ma mthong gi bar bsgrub/ de'i ring la dam nyams dang yug grib sogs mi gtsang ba mtha' dag la 'dzem/ bud med sogs dang nyal po spang*/ mdor na lha sgrub pa'i bgegs mtha' dag spangs la bsgrub par bya'o// de ltar bsgrubs nas grub pa'i mtshan ma mthong ma thag rtags gtor 'bul zhing*/ rten gtor sgul skyod med par sgrub khang gi phugs su bzhugs su gsol/ 'dzin gtor 'phral du gso zhing gtor bsngos dang mnga' gsol bskang ba ma chag par bya/

khyad par rab kyis dgu gsum/ 'bring gis dgu gnyis sam tshes bcu dang nyer dgu/ tha mas nyer dgu la las byang mnga' gsol bskang ba sogs ma chag par bya/ 'phral la lha'i bskyed rim dang bsnyen pa ma chag par bya ba sogs lha sgrub gzhan ltar bya zhing*/ lha dang bla ma la the tshom spangs pa'i yid ches par bya zhing rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig ma nyams pa dus dang yun du bya ba gal shin tu che'o// gnyis pa de ltar bsnyen pas lha rtags mthong ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ sgrub pa la 'jug pa la'ang gsum/ srung ba/ zlog pa/ bsad pa'o/ dang po srung ba ni/ bca' gzhi snga ma lta bu la/ rtsa sngags la srung sngags btags la bzla zhing*| gdugs ltar 'bubs pa'i tsakra dpe'u chung ltar bris la gtor ma'i steng nas dbub/ nang gzhug gi dkyil 'khor dpe'u ris ltar bris pa dri bzang dang dug khrag man ngag ltar byugs pa mgo mjug ma log par lcags sbubs sogs su bcug pa gtor ma'i nang du gzhug /sgrub pa thon nas tshur bton la rang gis tshags bya zhing*/ gdugs ltar 'bubs pa'i 'khor lo dang nang gzhug gi dkyil 'khor gnyis rjes su yang bldab chog /gtor ma'i rgyu sogs bsnyen dus ltar la de las che bar bya/ gtso bo la chu srin gyi zhal rngam 'don pa sogs mthong rgyud ltar bya/ srod thun ma gtogs pa thun lnga po thun gtor re re gnod byed kyi sha khrag tu dmigs la gtor chen la 'bul zhing bstod bskul gyi srung ba'i sham bu yig cha rnying pa la lar/ gtso bo'i gtor ma dug gtor dmar nag rtse gsum pa'ang bshad/ la lar chu srin gyi zhal rngam yang bshad/ khungs thub kyi yig cha rnying pa rnams su gtor ma zur gsum dmar nag ces pa tsam las gzhan la ma bshad pas spros pa la ma dga' na chu srin gyi zhal sogs ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon du mi 'gro ba kho nar nges so/ yum dang 'khor drug gi gtor ma grangs tshang ba gal che'o// yang zlog me'i spu gri ltar btags shing phrin las bcol/

srod thun gyi dus thun gtor las gshin gyis bskul la phyir 'phang*/ gzhan thams cad bsnyen dus ltar bya/ dmigs pa ni sa mā dhi dgu skor nyid yin no// gzhan srung ba'i lag len rnams ni yang zlog ltar bya zhing*/ srung rtags gshin rje'i bya lam nas bshad pa ltar byung na mtshams grol/ sgrub khang gi thog tu gser skyems phul nas/ gtor chen bskul ring bas bskul| dgug gzhug gsum sogs bya zhing gtor bsngos kyi mjug tu bsrung ba'i phrin las bcol/ slar bskul thung gis phyir spags/ las gshin gyi rbad bsad thun bskul dang de'i mthar/ bskul gyis gtor ma rnams thebs dang bstun la rgyag /gtor mnan sogs las gzhung ltar byas pas grub bo// gnyis pa zlog pa'i man ngag ni/ gza' skar rtsub cing drag po la g.yul bkyes pa'i sa la sogs pa bkra mi shis pa'i sa sna tshogs la stegs bu rgyar mda' gang*/ dpangs su khru gang ba'i dbus su/ brub khung gri lcags sam gong gi sa las byas pa kha khyer bang rim gsum ldan che chung 'tsham pa'i nang gri khrag la sogs pa khrag sna dug sna bsres pas dmar po dang*/ phyi ro sol gyis nag por byugs pa'i kha khyer la drag po'i rtsang phur la dug khrag dang*| gri khrag ro sol gyis sbags pa nyer brgyad srin mo'i 'gros su gzug rtse mor sha dum dang zan ling mgo mjug slog pas rgyan dgos par bshad do// stegs bu'i mthar yang bshad ma thag pa lta bu'i rtsang brgyad cu btsugs pa'i rtse rnams su dgra bo'i ling chung dang sha dum bskyon/ bca' gzhi 'di rgyud kyi dgongs pa yin zhing*/ kha cig ma traṃ gi lto bar chos 'byung gi dbus su bsham pa 'dug pa ni/ zor gdan dang bca' gzhi nor bas shin tu nongs so// de nas bshad ma thag pa'i brub khung du dgra'i bgegs la byed na rang la gang gnod de'i lha 'dre gnas pa'i sa rdo shing chu sogs liṅgar bsre ming yang de bzhin du bsgyur ba sogs zhal las shes so// dri ma drug gang rung dang bsres pa'i bag zan gyi liṅga'i snying gar byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa'i ming rus dug khrag gis bris pa bcug

/liṅga de la'ang dug khrag byugs la gan rkyal du brub khung du mgo rang la bstan pa bzhag /de'i steng du khri'u'am mañji'i khar sngar srung ba'i dus bshad pa lta bu'i gtor chen bris skus brgyan pa bsham/ las gshin la'ang sngar bshad pa ltar gtor ma gcig bsham/ stegs bu'i steng gi rtsang gi nang skor du/ spom nag /skyer pa/ ro bsregs pa'i shing ste gdug pa can gyi shing de gsum la/ 'ug pa/ srin bya/ pho rog ste ltas ngan de gsum gyi sgro bsgron pa'i mda' la gri lcags kyi mde'u sprad pa dug khrag gis sbags pa'i mdel mtshams su zlog pa'i sngags byang bris pa mchog chen gyi gzhu dang bcas pa'i mda' zor dang*/ ri gsum 'dus pa'i sa dang g.yul bkyes pa'i sa dang*/ dur khrod kyi sa la sogs pa bkra mi shis pa'i sa sna tshogs tshad dug chus sbrus pa/ la drag po'i kong bu zur gsum pa dpangs mtho gang rgyar ngos re rer sor bcu/ nang gri khrag dang mtshal byugs pa'i phyir ro sol dang dug khrag byugs pa'i nang du yungs kar nag dur rdo gri lcags sogs thun rdzas sna tshogs zlog bsad kyi sngags dang thun sngags kyis gzir ba/ thun sna tshogs pa blugs kha rtsang gis brgyan pa dang*/ 'di la kha bal tshon gyis bkab/ yang de nyid las byas pa'i khrag zor zur gsum dpangs su sor bzhi/ rgyar sor drug /phyi ro sol dang dug khrag /nang gri khrag mtshal gyis byugs pa'i nang du khrag sna tshogs blugs pa 'di kha bal tshon gyis bkab| rtsang gis brgyan pa'i khrag zor dang lcags sam bhan+dhar nas/ gro/ sran ma/ so ba/ 'bras te 'bru lnga po ngar phyer byas pa dug sna tshogs/ chang khrag gis sbrus pa'i gtor ma zur gsum mtho gang pa dug khrag gis sbags pa rgyan med pa mda' mdung mtshe yungs rtsang bco lnga gzug gis brgyan pa'i gtor zor te de lta bu'i zor rnams zor rdzas thams cad la dug shog dug khrag gis rtsa sngags dang sde brgyad kyi sngags sham du zlog bsad gang yin gyi sham bu thems bcas bris pa re re mda' la dkri zhing gzhan rnams kyi nang du gzhug go// rab phyogs mtshams brgyad steng 'og gnyis dang bcur 'phen pa'i dbang gis zor bzhi po bcu bcu dang*/

de ma 'byor na phyogs bzhir 'phang ba'i dbang gis bzhi bzhi po thams cad la zlog sngags bris pas brgyan cing*/ zlog bsad sngags kyis ngar blud pa dag phyogs rnams su spel nas zor bskul ltar snga phyi ma log par bsham/ de dag gi mdun du 'debs kha'i gtor ma lha grangs dang mnyam pa sha khrag gis sbags pa dang*| mthar mchod pa dang thun gtor sogs gong ltar bsham/ gdab las 'phral la bya rgyu lcags sam bhan+dhar dgra'i dri ma bsres pa'i zan ling nang du dgra'i ming rus bris pa bcug cing*/ dug khrag gis sbags pa gtor chung chang bu skyu gu dang bcas pa dang*/ gzhan yang phur bu/ thun mtshon cha la sogs pa gdab las la mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad tshogs par bsham/ de nas las byang sogs sngar bshad pa ltar las tshogs mchod gung thun la bya/ rtsang gyer zlog gzhung la sogs pa smad las thams cad dgong thun dang srod thun la bya/ dus drug tu thun gtor las gshin gyis bskul bas gang gnod pa'i dgra phyogs su 'phang zhing bskul gyi sngon du dgug gzhug gsum re dang gtor bsngos bya zhing bzlog pa'i 'dod gsol bya/ zlog pa'i dmigs pa ri rab khong nyul ltar las byang du bris yod pas de ltar bsgom zhing rtsa sngags mjug tu zlog pa'i sham bu btags la bzla zhing*/ zlog pa'i rtags gshin rje bya lam srung thabs su bshad pa ltar mthong nas/ brub khung nang gi liṅga tshur bton nas gdab las byas la 'bul/ sgrub khang gi thog tu gser skyems mjug la zor rnams rang rang gi bskul gyis phyogs mtshams su 'phang*/ gtor chen bskul ba sogs srung ba'i dus ltar bya/ de ltar zlog pa'i man ngag 'di'ang srung ba'i mthar sbrel na 'thad cing de ltar byed na bca' gzhi srung ba'i gong nas bya dgos so// brub khung nang gi liṅga la'ang zlog pa'i ring la srod thun gyi thog tsam la nub re bzhin 'gugs 'dren lha dbye sogs gdab las ltar bya'o// gzhan yang zlog pa'i lag len rnams ni yang zlog me'i spu gri ltar bya'o// gsum pa bsad pa'i man ngag ni/

brub khung dang gtor chen zor la sogs pa zlog pa'i dus ltar byas la/ 'chi sbyor sogs la zin phung la sogs rgyu ba dang bstun nas/ ro ras sam dug shog la/ dug sna/ khrag sna/ snag tsha dang bsres la dug gsum khros pa g.yas seng zhal/ g.yon phag zhal/ dbus chu srin gyi zhal can g.yas dang po dang tha ma ral gri/ bar pa khram shing*/ g.yon dang pos klu'i mjug ma nas bzung ba/ bar pa sbrul zhags/ tha ma rdo rje'i zhags pa thogs pa zhabs gnyis gel pa'i stabs kyis dgra gzugs sbrul gyis bcings pa'i steng du gnas pa/ stag sham can rus pas brgyan pa/ skra brdzes pa/ tshon rtsis bsgyur ba'i lto ba yangs par byas pa'i nang du dgra'i liṅga mgo las gshin gyi gsang gnas su bstan pa/ lcags sgrog gis bcings pa/ de'i g.yas su sbrul/ g.yon du phag /gsang bar bya gzugs rnams kyi mchu dang pos liṅga la za tshul can spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram gyis mnan pa'i mthar bsad pa'i sngags mgo nang du bstan pas bskor/ liṅga'i bgegs la byed na zhal las shes shing rdzas ni dgra bgegs khyad med do/ gnas yig gshin rje yang zlog ltar bkod/ liṅga'i khog par dgra du yod kyi ming rus bri/ las gshin gyi gzugs kyi mthar dzaḥkhram gyis bskor/ de lta bu'i rgyab phyogs su kho'i lha srung ban dgra yin na kho rang gi chos skyong gi ming dang sngags mthar kho rang gi ming rus dang dmod mo 'bri dgos/ gi snying po dang kho'i pha tshan yul zhing mkhar la sogs pa bri/ dug sna dang khrag mdze khrag dang yug sa'i mngal khrag phug ron gyi khrag rnams med du mi rung gzhan khrag sna ci 'dzom bya'o// sna byug /liṅga la kho'i zag rdzas byug /las gshin la mi byug /yang ro ras sam dug shog la dgra du yod pa'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i ling rkyang bsad sngags dang dzaḥkhram gyis bskor/ khong par ming rus dang rgyab logs su kho rang so so'i lha'i sngags dang pha tshan yul mkhar gyi ming bris pa dug khrag gis byugs pa'ang bya/

de lta bu'i ling rkyang rnams gong gi las gshin gyi gzugs yod pa'i liṅga de'i steng du brtsegs/ snying gar gri lcags kyi phur bus nṛ mig ma bug tsam gzer la thun thag tshur drangs pa'i sne rang gis bzung dgos/ yang khro chu'i gzhung du phur bu ma gtogs thun thag gsal kha ma bshad pas ma byas kyang rung*/ byed na shi skra'am gri rgyus la bya/ gri lcags kyi phur bu gzhung nas bshad pas med du mi rung bas dgos so// de nas rabs chad 'di nges par thod pa zhal dbye ba zhig med du mi rung ngo*// thod pa gas chag med pa'i de'ang dgra mang na brub khung du bcug nyung na thod pa'i nang du brkyangs la bzhag ces bshad do// klad khung nas bcug la thod pa de sngar gyi brub khung du klad khung gnam la bstan cing kha mig rang ngos la bstan la bzhag /brub khung kha ro g.yam la rdo rje rgya gram dang ri rab bris shing thun khung phur pa zhig gis bcad/ thun thun phur dang thun khung gyi phur pa gnyis gshin rje dmar nag zhal gnyis kyi g.yas ral gri dang g.yon sdigs mdzub kyis thun thag zhags pa'i tshul du 'dzin pa zhabs gnyis mchong stabs su e ru rngams pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa g.yon gyi zhags pas dgra bgegs kyi ske la bcings par bsam mo// khung de'ang gri lcags kyi phur pas bcad la bzhag /thun khung ma gtogs pa brub khung nang du dkar cha dang rlung cung zad tsam yang mi thar bar bya/ de dag gi nye logs su thod pa mtshan ngan gyi nang du/ dug sna/ khrag sna/ sa sna sbrus pa'i yungs thun dkar nag /lcags phye/ thun rdzas la gri lcags kyi phye ma med du mi rung ngo*// zangs phye rnams bsres pa'i thun yang bzhag /mtha' bsgyur mnan sreg gi rdzas rnams kyang rang gzhung nas bshad pa ltar 'du bya/ gzhan thams cad zlog pa'i dus ltar bya zhing*/ 'phral la gdab las byed pa'i zan ling la sogs pa'ang sngar ltar 'du bya'o// de nas las gzhung sogs sngar ltar las bsad pa'i dmigs pa bdud bzhi gshed 'bebs las byang du bshad pa ltar bsgom zhing*/

rtsa sngags la bsad sngags btags la bzla/ mkhyen gzu dpang btsugs sogs rgyas par bya/ brub khung bskyed pa sogs bya zhing*/ thun drug tu 'gugs 'dren dang bla 'gugs pa'i sngags stong tsho gsum re bzla/ dgong thun la rtsang bstod la sogs pa zlog pa'i gzhung bsrang zhing 'debs kha la sogs pa'i 'don cha thams cad bya/ srod thun dus thod pa'i liṅga la dmigs pa'i brub khung bskyed cing bla 'gugs lha dbye rnams bya zhing zan ling la gdab las byas la 'bul/ mtshams dang ngag bcad dam par bya/ cung zad kyang mi g.yel bar 'bad la bsgrub/ sgrub pa 'di'i dus su phrin las bskul ba la gtso bor bya/ de'ang phyi pa mu stegs pa dang bon po sogs la byed na zlog bsad spel zhing 'don cha sogs rgyas par bya/ sgrub pa yun bsring*/ skye bo phal pa dang bud med la cung zad tsam re sgrub pa yun thung ba bya/ nang pa dang*/ dge bshes/ sngags pa/ rgyal po la sogs la las sgrub 'di nyid kyi skabs su bab pa'i 'don cha ma gtogs chos spyod dang bskang gso zur pa ci yang mi byed par nag sgrub kho na bya ste/ de ni mu stegs ltar sgrub pa zhes shin tu rtags myur zhing rno ba yin no// bla khug pa'i rtags nges pa can gsum yan chad ma byung gi bar du thod pa'i liṅga la thun brab pa sogs mi bya zhing bla khug pa'i rtags ma byung bar bsad las byas na phyis dgra sod par mi 'gyur bas khug rtags thon pa gal che'o| |dus drug la thun gtor la dgug gzhug gsum sogs bya zhing dgra bo'i sha khrag tu dmigs la 'bul/ slar thun gtor gshin rje'i dmag tshogs su bsams la/ las gshin gyis bskul la dgra phyogs su 'phang*/ de ltar bsgrubs pas rtags nges pa can byung na thun gyis gzir ba ni/ sngar bshad pa'i thun la bsad sngags mang du bzlas pas ngar blud pa dus drug tu thod pa'i liṅga la brab cing*/ thun rbad sod thun bskul gyi mjug tu/

sngags 'di bsad sngags la btags la brab bo/ ya ma rak+sha/ kro dha pa tsa la/ dgra bo'i rtsa drug ta thun ta sha ku ru tra thun ra ga tsit+ta rbad ya ma ya ka sha la dza dzaḥ bh+yo bh+yo snying kha rak+mo/ dgra bo'i rtsa la thun/ nag po tsit+ta dgra bo'i srog thun/ ya ma rā dza dgra bo'i srog la thun ya/ tri na dgra bo'i dbugs la thun/ ma ma tri na dgra bo'i snying la thun/ ha ri ya sha dgra bo'i snying la thun/ rā tsa snying phug /ha sha snying kha raka ma mo rā dza dgra bo'i dbugs la thun/ ha ri ya sha dgra bo'i snying khrag sham mo thun thun bh+yo bh+yoḥ zhes thun khung gi phur pa tshur bton nas thun rdeg pa'i tshe/ dmigs pa ni/ brub khung gi nang du dug gi mtsho 'khrugs pa'i nang du las kyi gshin rje nag po shin tu 'jigs pa/ khro ba/ rngam pa/ lus las nad dang*/ dug dang*/ mtshon cha'i char 'bebs pa/ zhal gru gsum yar gdangs pa/ mche ba gangs ri ltar gtsigs pa/ ljags las me stag gi tsha tsha 'phro ba/ brub khung du gan rkyal du yod pa'i zhal gyi nang du byad ma de yod par bsam/ bdag gis thun brgyab pas nad dang*/ dug dang*/ mtshon cha'i char phab nas dgra bo de bsad bcad gtubs shing lus dum bur brlag par bsam/ thun brgyab zin nas phur khung phur bus bcad pa'i tshe gshin rje de'ang zhal btsums mche ba bsdams pas dgra bo de 'gul dbang med pa sbrul par bur bcug pa lta bur gyur par bsam/ yang skabs su byad ma'i khong par gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud med pa gnyis bsnol mar 'khor bas kho'i srog rtsa/ snying rtsa/ khrag rtsa thams cad rbad rbad bcad cing sha khrag dmar tha ra ra btang ba las kyi gshin rje'i dmag tshogs rnams kyis sha zos khrag 'thung rus mur ming yang med par brlag par bsam/ dus rtag tu las byang du bshad pa'i bdud bzhi gshed 'bebs kho na bsgom zhing bsad sngags la 'bad/ dus drug tu thun gtor gshin rje'i las kyi bshan pa dug gsum khros pa'i dmag tu bsams la/ rbad sod thun bskul gyi mthar/

las gshin gyi bskul bya zhing*/ brub khung du rgyab pa'i tshe las kyi gshin rjes dgra bo de bsad bcad sha rus zos par bsams la brub khung du rdeg go// gzhan yang bsad pa'i sgrub pa bya tshul 'dir mi gsal ba rnams yang zlog me'i spu gri'i sgrub gzhung ltar 'bad pas bsgrubs shing*/ bsad rtags rnams gshin rje bya lam srung thabs nas bshad pa ltar ram/ gzhan yang mngon spyod kyi spyi gzhung srid pa gter khyim dang gser thur rnam gsum sogs nas bshad pa lta bu'i mtshan ma brtan po ma mthong bar bsad pa'i nang rtags nges pa can lan kha yar byung nas bsad las 'phro bcad la chos skyong ngal gso ba'i phyir yud tsam bzhag bsad las tshad las thal na sngags pa gri ru 'chi ba'i nyes pa yod do// de bas nang rtags mkhas dgos so// 'bad/ skabs skabs su sngags bsdebs ltar tshe zad las zad kyi sbyor ba dang*/ sde brgyad bskul ba sogs kyang bya/ yang skabs skabs su zhal gdams phar 'phro tshur 'phro'i dmigs pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las lcags kyu lta bu'i 'od zer 'phros/ dmigs pa'i dgra de'i snying la phog ma thag /dgra de'i snying gi nang na rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo nṛ ljang gu gnas pa la phog /de nyid rdo khab len gyis lcags bsdus pa ltar bkug nas liṅga'i nṛ la bstim/ de nas rang gi sna bug gnyis nas rlung phar rgyu ba'i tshe rlung dang lhan cig tu rang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib tshe'i bar chad la sogs pa thams cad phar thon nas thun khung du dgra bo dngos su gsal ba de'i sna bug tu phar la zhugs nas snying nang gi rnam shes kyi yig 'bru nṛ+-i la thim| yang kho'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor bkrag mdangs gzi brjid thams cad kho rang gi sna bug nas phyir thon bdag gi sna bug gi rlung nang du rngub pa dang lhan cig tu bdag gi sna bug gnyis su zhugs te snying gar 'dus pas bdag nyid kyang bkrag mdangs gzi brjid nyi ma ltar 'bar zhing tshe'i grub pa thob/

gzas pa po nag hrul hrul por song bar yang bsam/ dgug gzhug dang bla 'gugs kyi dus rang gi thugs ka nas bla gshed kyi pho nya gnod sbyin srin po la sogs pa brgyad spros te kho'i bla 'khyam mi la sogs pa brgyad du brdzus pa skad cig gis bkug nas liṅga la bstim par bsam zhing bla 'gugs gdab las ltar gyer/ yang lha dbye'i dus bdag gi thugs ka nas khro bo chen po gnyis dbu dang gshog pa bya rog dang 'ug pa gzhan yi dam khro bo'i cha byad can dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang ldan pa gnyis kyis phyag so sor rang rang gi dang sgro thogs nas byad ma'i steng gi thad kyi nam mkhar phar lding tshul lding byed cing gshog pa brab cing sgros byabs pas byad ma'i srung skyob mkhan gyi lha srung thams cad bya rog 'ur rdos ded pa ltar phyi'i rgya mtsho'i phar mthar bskrad pas kho skyob byed thams cad dang bral zhing gsod byed kyi sde brgyad bshan pa thams cad dang phrad nas 'dar phril phril yod par bsam mo// lha srung gis kho skyob pa'i rtags so sor byung na de dag so sor dbye ba'i cho ga dang bla dwags brgyad po gang byung ba de nyid 'gugs pa'i sngags dang*/ bla phur/ snying phur/ srog phur gsum po'i cho ga sogs ni yang zlog gi nang ltar shes par bya dgos shing*/ lha dbye'i rdzas rnams ni srid pa gter khyim du bshad pa ltar byas na legs so// de ltar bsad pa'i rtags rnams rdzogs pa'i nges pa brtan po rnyed nas/ tshe khrus lung gi dgongs pa gnas ma spar na sngags pa nag po ru drar gol ba'i nyes pa 'byung bas des na/ gtad dang mnan pa ma gtogs pa sbyin sreg dang gdab las las gshin gyi lto bar dug gsum gnad 'bebs yod pa'i liṅga de la sogs pa sreg pa dang gdab las bgos pas/ byed rgyu'i liṅga rnams sla nga sogs lcags snod du tshur bton/ gtad mnan byed rgyu'i liṅga rnams sngar ltar thod par bcug la bzhag

/de nas dpang gzu mkhyen gsol dang thun gtor zor sogs brgyab la bsgral khar/ rang gi lag pa'i phur bu'i rtse'i dbal gyi zur gsum du phaṭa gsum dang ldebs gsum du hūm̐ gsum gyis mtshan pa de nyid/ gzas pa po de'i snying gi nang du tshe'i ba rgya khrag gi dwangs ma bye'u'i sgo nga tsam gyi nang du tshe'i ngo bo a dkar po/ de'i nang du srog gi ngo bo nṛ ljang dmar gnas pa de la btab pas tshe'i rgya dbral nas a nṛ dang bcas yer gyis phur bu'i dbal rtses blangs te kho'i nyon mongs nyes ltung thams cad kho rang gi phung po ling ro dang lhan cig tu bzhag nas/ rang gi snying gar bcug pas/ tshe'i ngo bo de zhu nas rang la thim pas rang nyid tshe dpal thams cad shin tu rgyas par byed pa ni tshe lung gi dgongs pa dang*/ de dag gis kho'i nyon mongs pa dang bral te sems dag pa'i ngo bo yin yang*/ da dung gla rtsi'i thum shun la gla rtsi dngos med kyang dri 'byung ba ltar/ kho'i bag chags kyi dri ma phran bu dang*/ bdag nyid kyi rtsol grib kyi dri mas gos pa'ang srid pas de sbyang ba'i phyir/ slar phur bu'i dbal rtses rang gi snying ga nas hūm̐ gsum gyi kho'i srog gi dwangs ma nṛ yig de tshur blangs te phaṭa phur bu'i rtse mo gyen du bstan pa tsam gyis/ gsum gyis 'og min du 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi thugs kar 'phang lha'i thugs dang kho'i rnam shes dbyer med du bsres te bzhag /pas chos kyi sku 'grub par byas/ slar yab kyi sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar bab pa 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i sras su longs sku nges pa lnga ldan du byon pas longs sku'i go 'phang thob par byas/ slar yang rang rang gang 'dul gyi don du mkha' gsang de nyid las phyir 'phros te/ zhing khams thams cad dag pa gnyis ldan gyi skur byon pa ni sprul sku'i go 'phang thob par byas pa rnams ni khrus lung gi dgongs pa dag go// de'i mod la rang nyid rlung ro sangs kyis 'bud/

lta stangs nam mkha' la cher bya/ rang rig pa'i ye shes ngos bzung la dbyings rig bsre/ shes pa hur ling nge byas pa dal cig mnyam par bzhag go// de nas ling ro gdab las ltar mtshon gyis gtubs nas phyed tsam gtor mar bsgron nas kho'i sha khrag rnams gshin rje'i lha tshogs la tshogs mchod du phul bas kho tshogs gnyis skad cig la rdzogs nas khos gtso byas bdag gzhan sems can thams cad pha rol tu phyin pa drug rdzogs nas byang chub thob pa'i rgyur gyur par bsam/ gsum pa las la sbyar ba ni/ las kyi mtha' rgyas bstan pa yin te/ 'di la'ang gsum/ sreg pa/ 'phang ba/ mnan pa'o// dang po sreg pa ni/ khro chu'i gzhung nas bshad pa lta bu'am/ drag po'i sreg chog gzhan gyis kyang rgyas bkab nas ling ro rnams dang*/ rgyas par na ling chung brgya rtsa brgyad slar bris nas phul yang rung la/ bsdus par na ling ro kho nas kyang rung la/ de dag gang byed kyang sbyin sreg lugs mthun rdzas sna bcu gsum/ me lha gnyis dang ldan pa nyid grub na shin tu legs shing*/ de'ang ma grub na drag po'i shing dug khrag gis sbags pa gru gsum du brtsegs la me sbar nas lha tshogs bskyed pa nas/ bstod pa'i bar las byang ltar byas nas ling ro dgra bo'i sha khrag tu dmigs nas 'bul zhing sman raka gtor gsum gyis mchod/ bstod bskul/ bzod gsol/ gshegs bsdu sogs las byang ltar byas la me dug khrag gis gzhil lo// gnyis pa 'phang ba ni/ zor gyis dgra bgegs bsad pa'i don yin pas| sgrub khang gi thog steng du zhing lpags sam/ gcan gzan gyi pags pa'i steng du ma traṃ gi lto bar chos 'byung bsnol ma'i dbus su sngar gyi maṇ+ḍal mthar bkod pa'i zor rnams bsham/ gser skyems dkar gtor la sogs pa'ang bsham/ dar phyar/ dung 'bud/ bsang bya/ gzhi bdag la dkar gtor de sbyin/ de nas gser skyems 'bul/ de'i mjug tu zor rdzas rnams rang rang gi bskul gyis 'phang*/

de'ang zor bcu yod na phyogs mtshams brgyad steng 'og gnyis dang bcur 'phang*/ bzhi yod na phyogs bzhir 'phang*/ gcig las med na gang gnod pa'i phyogs su 'phang ngo*// de nas nang du 'ongs nas gtor chen bskul ba nas gtor mnan gyi bar las byang ltar dang mthong rgyud ltar byas la 'phang*/ gza' sa bdag sde brgyad kyi rgyu dus mnan gtad du mchod rdzas dpa' bo'i mtshon cha zhes pa khro chu rang gi chos tshan du yod pa de lags so// thebs dang bstun pa shin tu gal che zhing*/ sbyin sreg gi thal sol dum zhig gtor chen la sgron pa'ang man ngag gnad zab bo// gsum pa mnan pa'i las la'ang gnyis/ sa la mnan pa dang*/ klu la gtad pa'o// dang po sa la mnan par 'dod na/ ling rkyang dpral bar raṃ nyer gcig /spyi bor nan nyer gcig /'gram pa g.yas la rbad nyer gcig /g.yon du sod nyer gcig /mig gnyis la rmugs bdun re/ khar lkug /spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram bri/ liṅga'i mthar spyi bo nas brtsams te sngags mgo phyir bstan la/ du tri nas/ pa tsa'i mjug tu dgra bo che ge mo'i sa khams nan/ de bzhin du/ rlung khams nan/ chu khams nan/ me khams nan/ nam mkha'i khams nan/ snga dgra lag la brdar ba'i dgra bo nan/ phyi dgra zhe la bsam pa'i= da dgra dngos su 'khu ba'i= rgyab nas 'ded pa'i= sngun la rgyug pa'i= mgo la sprel ltar 'dzegs pa'i= lus la grib ltar 'grogs pa'i= brgya mi mang gis gleng ba'i= stong bra mang gis rtsod pa'i= dgra sdang bas dngos su 'tshe ba'i= gnyen byams pas lkog tu gleng ba'i= gzhan gyi byol zor mthu gtad lo zla zhag dus kyi skag ngan mo ltas rmi lam ngan pa thams cad s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ bya ba dang gzhan yang dmod pa shes tshad kyis bskor/ phyi rol dzaḥkhram gyis bskor/ dug sna dang khrag sna byug /liṅga'i khog par dmigs bya yod na de'i ming rus nṛ la dri rdzas byug /dmigs bya med na dgra mnan spyi 'gro kha la rgyas 'debs ltar bya/

de nas brub khung du thod pa bcug la gong gi sngags zhag bdun sogs rtags dang sbyar la bsgrub/ rtags thon nas shi yug gi skras bcings/ thod ngan nam/ spyang thod dam| phag thod du bcug /phung res dril/ thod pa'i nang du sngar gyi sbyin sreg gi thal ba dum zhig kyang blug /tshon skud kyis bsdam/ rtsang dang khro zhal gyis rgyas btab la/ lha khang gi them 'og gam/ mchod rten byin can gyi 'og gam/ sde brgyad gnas nges pa'i ri brag shing sogs kyi rtsa ba'am/ zam dngur ram/ lam rgya gram sogs su dong gru gsum khru zabs su/ gsum brus la las gshin bskyed nas de la gtad par bsams la dong du rbad sod thun bskul dang las gshin gyis bskul bas/ brub/ steng du ro g.yam la rdo rje rgya gram dang ri rab gling bzhi bris pas mnan/ de'i steng du 'byung ba bzhis rgyas gdab/ de'i steng du rta bro las byang ltar byas nang du 'ongs nas bzlas sgom la 'bad/ de ni mnan pa'i shog dril me'i rang bzhin cang shes kyi rgya can zhes bya ba'i zab don bsdus nas bshad pa'o// gnyis pa las mjug gdug pa klu la gtad par 'dod na/ ling rkyang sbrul nag gnyis kyis bcings pa gnas yig spyi 'gro ltar dang khong par ming rus dmod mo gtad kyi kha bsgyur can bri/ sbrul dang liṅga'i bar du rū pa'i mgo nas g.yas ngos su du tri nas pa tsa ya can sngags gsum gyi mjug tu/ oṃ pho sngags bdun cu don gcig pa yin no bsre bslad ma byed/ nag po ti pa tsa ya nā ga rak+sha: he khu lang : phe shan phos phos shig shig: chum chum: klu nag po mgo dgu pas: dgra bo che ge mo zung zung : chings chings: nā ga 'du: nā ga zhen 'du: he ling rge mi 'dus 'dus: nag po baṃ tsi tsi rgyas: traka thur snying la gul gul: myogs myogs: rtsa bzhi khum: shan shan srog la shan: thur sod: ces pa'i mjug tu dmod mo ci shes sbyar la mgo nang du bstan pas bskor/

yang liṅga'i mgo nas g.yon ngos su sngags gsum gyi mjug tu/ mo sngags bzhi bcu zhe lnga pa yin bcos lhad ma byed/ nā ga gur ling snying la 'dus 'dus: snying khrag baṃ mo rul snying la 'dus 'dus: nā ga ken tse snying la 'dus 'dus: nā ga 'dus nā ga 'dus: ni ya 'dus 'dus: ni long ni chod: sa ma ya dam dza dzaḥ zhes pa'i mjug tu dmod pa ci shes btags pa mgo phyir bstan pas bskor/ ling khrus byas la/ dgra'i zag rdzas dang*/ dkar gsum/ mngar gsum/ nad mdzes khyer bar 'dod na mdze khrag byug /grir 'chi bar 'dod na gri khrag byug /rims kyis 'chi bar 'dod na rims khrag byug /de la sogs nad gang 'dod rdzas kyis kha bsgyur ba gal che'o// kyi kha bsgyur gyis byug /rdza'i sbal pa'am/ mdze thod du bcug /sngar gyi sbyin sreg gi thal sol dum zhig blugs la brub khung du bcug /sngags gsum gyi mjug tu nā ga gur ling ma can btags la bsgrub/ zhag grangs lnga'am bdun bzlas pas/ khye'u bu mo bka' nyan dang*// sbal sbrul mang po khrol ba dang*// phyugs ma mang po byed pa dang*// de rnams 'grub pa'i rtags su bstan// sdong po sta gris bcad pa dang*// lo tog zor bas 'debs pa dang*// brag chen 'jor kyis gshag pa dang*// rdo chen tho bas gcog pa dang*// zhing la 'od pa gtong ba dang*| |ba lang gnya' gtod zhing rmo dang*// de dag las rnams grub pa'i rtags// de las log pa zlog pa yin// zhes so// rtags rnams rdzogs nas sde brgyad gnas nges pa'i mtsho'am| klu bdud gnas nges pa'i chu mig la gtad/ chu mig las mtsho dga'/ mtsho 'phral 'jam yang thul che bas dgra mang na dga'/ chu mig phral rtsub thul chung bas grangs nyung na dga'| bsgrubs pa'i yungs kar la sgrub sngags bzlas la brab/ de'i ring la grogs gcig gis chab gtor btang*/ de ltar 'grub pa'i mtshan ma mthong nas sgrib shing la sogs pa bsrung ba'i thabs rten 'brel rjes gcod la sogs pa gtad kyi gdams pa bcud phur lnga pa dang gtad kyi gzer dgu nas bshad pa ltar khyer nas mtsho'am chu mig gi rtsar phyin la/

dang po chab gtor btang de nas grogs gcig gis nā ga gur ling ma ci 'grub dang*/ dam tshig lañjar 'bri / 'bru dgu pa bzla/ rang gshin rje'am klu bdud du bsgom/ dgug gzhug dmod mo dang rbad sod thul bskul gyi rjes su/ las gshin gyi bskul ba dang bcas pas gtad brgyab/ brgyab zin nas rjes gcod gzhung nas bshad pa ltar bya zhing rang bya khyung du bsgom/ mtsho yin na mtsho'i zangs kha gang yin na 'phang thebs ldog rtsi ba gal che/ gtad byed nyin tshur log na gnam 'tshub cing rlung 'tshub dang ser ba 'bebs/ phar la thebs 'dod na gnam 'jam zhing shar nas sprin zor ba 'dra ba byung na thebs rtags yin/ mtsho gtad mi len na gtad mtsho'i steng du sdod cing mtsho khol yong*/ mtsho dang chu mig gi nang du mi gtang ba gsum ni/ rang gi grib ma dang*/ dri ma dang*/ kha rlangs gsum mi gtang*/ gtad zin nas dgra la rtags ma thon bar du dgong re bzhin chu gtor btang la dgra phyogs su gtor/ gshin rje'i thun gtor 'phang ngo*// mdor na las mjug klu la gtad pa 'di ni bsnyen pa thems/ dam tshig gtsang*/ lag len mkhas/ rtogs pa bzang*/ snying rje che ba'i rnal 'byor pa dag gi spyod yul yin no// de'ang 'phang sreg ni dgra bgegs gang la'ang rung la/ dgra bo spyi dang*/ bgegs dang*/ 'dre gdon la mnan pa shis so/ dgra bo dmigs bsal la gtad byas na mthu myur ba yin no// de ltar las sbyor gang byed kyang byas zin nas dgra rtags ma thon bar du zor yang yang 'phang dpung la 'bad/ bdag nyid 'khor bcas srung zlog gi rim pa la 'bad do// rtags thon nas gtang rag rgyas par gtang*/ mdor na bsad pa'i skabs 'dir mi gsal ba thams cad mngon spyod kyi spyi gzhung rnams su rtogs par bya dgos pa kho na dag go// de ltar 'jam dpal khro chu dug gdong nag po'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor kyi zab gnad dgos nges rnams sngon chad khro chu rang gi yig cha rnams su 'thor nas 'dug pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa bca' gzhi lag len gyi shog dril 'di ni/

'bri gung pa 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pas/ shing byi smin drug zla ba'i tshes bco brgyad la gzhu smad spro lung du sbyar ba yin gyi/ 'di ni rang re'i brgyud pa 'dzin nges dam tshig gtsang ba re re tsam ma gtogs kun la spel na las kyi gshin rjes bka'i chad pa myur du chod cig /'di la rang bzo dang gzhan gyi bsre lhad ma byed cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ//
